info.name: final_collection
info.description:
Gradmo mobile/web API collection.

• Set collection variables: base_url, access_token (from api/user/login).
• Folder "API — routes.php (314–415) additions" — batch homework, notes, exams, etc.
• Folder "API — routes (416–461) Zoom, exams, teacher" — live class, Zoom REST, teacher batch CRUD.
• Folder "API — synced from routes.php (remaining)" — any routes still missing.
• Zoom-only subset: import Zoom_APIs.postman_collection.json from project root.

+ Folder "Zoom (live class & recordings)" appended without changing existing requests.

item.name: API — routes.php (314–415) additions
item.description: Matches application/config/routes.php. Same style as this collection: POST, formdata, url host {{base_url}}api, path segments. Bearer auth on collection applies. PHP read_request_data() accepts form fields and JSON.

item.name: API — routes (416–461) Zoom, exams, teacher
item.description: Endpoints from routes.php lines 408–461 (Zoom, recordings, teacher batch CRUD, exam submissions). Import Zoom_APIs.postman_collection.json for a Zoom-focused set.

item.name: Zoom (live class & recordings)
item.description:
Batch Zoom REST + live class + recordings.

Auth: Bearer {{access_token}} (from api/user/login). Credentials: table zoom_api_credentials. Meetings: batch_zoom_meetings.

Run installer/create_batch_zoom_meetings_and_zoom_s2s.sql and add_zoom_meeting_sdk_columns.sql on DB.

request.description: List live classes for a batch (live_class_history + batch Zoom room if active).
Join payload: meeting SDK signature, join_url, password from batch_zoom_meetings + zoom_api_credentials.
Use live_class_id=0 + batch_id when no live_class_history row yet (batch-level Zoom room).
Students poll every ~2s: classStarted, classEnded, studentCanJoin, shouldAutoDisconnect.
Teacher/institute: sets host_joined_at, notifies students. Auth: teacher or institute.
Teacher ends class: batch_zoom_meetings status=0, recording stub, student notifications.
Teacher/institute: fan-out in-app notifications to enrolled students.
Active linked meeting for batch. Student/teacher/institute with batch access.
Creates Zoom meeting via S2S OAuth (zoom_api_credentials). Teacher/institute only.
Teacher/institute: patch topic/agenda/duration on Zoom + DB.
Teacher/institute: delete on Zoom and mark batch_zoom_meetings status=0.
List batch_zoom_recordings; auto-syncs processing rows when needed.
Single recording with playback URL when ready.
Teacher/institute: pull recordings from Zoom for one batch.
No auth. Run every 5 minutes via cron/scheduler.
Configure in Zoom app: {{base_url}}api/batch/zoom-webhook. Verifies webhook_secret from zoom_api_credentials.
Raw Zoom API response for troubleshooting meeting/recordings.

item.name: Admin (website — zoom_api_credentials)
item.description: Not REST api/batch — save global Zoom keys via admin session (Ajax).

request.description: Admin Live Class page. Requires admin PHP session cookie (not Bearer token).
